snippet.title: My First NYC Apartment: What I Learned After 4 Months
snippet.description:
Moving to NYC alone has been one of the most challenging and rewarding experiences of my life. In this video, I’m sharing everything I’ve learned after 4 months of living in my first NYC apartment — from small-space living and unexpected building quirks to commuting tips, budgeting, and what day-to-day life actually feels like.

If you’re thinking about moving to New York, curious about real NYC living costs, or just love apartment and city-life content, I hope this gives you a realistic and honest look at what to expect.

✨ In this video:
 • How much I spend each month (with a full breakdown)
 • What I’ve learned about small-space living
 • My NYC apartment realities (noise, neighbors, maintenance)
 • Subway and commute tips that actually matter
 • The independence & personal growth that comes with living alone

As always, this is just my experience — everyone’s lifestyle and priorities are different, and yours might look completely different than mine!

📍Let me know in the comments: What surprised you when you moved into your first apartment? What do you think about living in NYC?
